summary.name: Phorge
summary.one_liner: Phorge is a community-driven platform for collaborating on, managing, organizing and reviewing software development projects, listed as an Apache-2.0 licensed PHP project.
summary.what_it_does: The page itself is only an anti-bot interstitial (Anubis proof-of-work check) and contains no product details. The listing describes Phorge as a community-driven platform for collaborating on, managing, organizing and reviewing software development projects. It is categorized under Project Management in the awesome-selfhosted list and written in PHP under Apache-2.0. Specific features could not be verified from this page.
caveats: The fetched page was only an anti-bot challenge; product features were not verified from it
Requires JavaScript; browser plugins such as JShelter may block access to the site
